Hospitalia

Concept project · Healthcare app & identity

The brief

What if understanding your care didn't depend on waiting for a translator?

3User personas
Lead Designer &
Brand StrategistRole

Patients who don't speak English often wait for translators or miss key information. Hospitalia is a calm, human healthcare brand and an AI app that helps families find their way and translate in the moment.

IllustratorPhotoshopInDesignAfter Effects

User personas

Three people, one barrier

Three caregivers, one language barrier.

Carlos MendezConstruction Worker

"I just want to make sure my wife gets the best care without feeling lost or misunderstood."

CompassionateDetermined
Goals
  • Ensure his wife gets the best care while in the hospital.
  • Communicate effectively with hospital staff despite language barriers.
  • Quickly navigate the hospital to get to the right department.
Frustrations
  • Limited English proficiency makes it hard to understand medical instructions.
  • Difficulty finding his way around the hospital.
  • Long waiting times and lack of clear communication from hospital staff.
Age35
LocationSan Antonio, TX
FamilyMarried, two young children
EducationHigh school diploma
Emily ChenMedical Research Assistant

"I need an app that bridges the language gap and helps me support my grandmother's care without disrupting my work."

EmpatheticOrganized
Goals
  • Quickly and accurately translate medical jargon for her elderly, non-English-speaking grandmother.
  • Efficiently move between departments for her job and personal visits.
  • Access medical records and instructions in both English and Mandarin.
Frustrations
  • Finding time to assist her grandmother while managing a demanding job.
  • Miscommunications with medical staff regarding her grandmother's care.
  • Navigating the large hospital campus and locating specific departments.
Age24
LocationLos Angeles, CA
FamilySingle, lives with roommates
EducationBS in Biology
Rajiv PatelBusiness Executive

"I need a reliable tool to help me stay on top of my father's care while juggling my professional responsibilities."

AnalyticalPatient
Goals
  • Ensure his father receives top-quality medical care.
  • Communicate effectively with healthcare providers and understand their instructions.
  • Manage his time efficiently between work and hospital visits.
Frustrations
  • Balancing a demanding job with the need to be present at the hospital.
  • Keeping track of medical appointments and instructions.
  • Ensuring his father, who speaks limited English, understands his care plan.
Age52
LocationEdison, NJ
FamilyMarried, three teenagers
EducationMBA
